overview.title: Overview
overview.intro: Internal tools for running YourTal. Every action you take here is recorded.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: This area is for YourTal staff only. If you think you should have access, ask a staff administrator.

errors.actionFailed: That action could not be completed. Try again.

businesses.pageDescription: Review KYB submissions and manage business suspensions.
businesses.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No businesses} one {# business} other {# businesses}}
businesses.emptyDescription: Try a different search, or clear it to see every business.
businesses.tableCaption: Businesses, their region, KYB status and suspension status
businesses.noDocuments: No documents have been submitted yet.
businesses.approveKybDialogBody: Every submitted document is marked verified and the business becomes verified.
businesses.rejectKybDialogBody: Every submitted document is marked rejected. The business stays unverified.
businesses.suspendDialogBody: Its campaigns leave the feed immediately, and it cannot submit or spend while suspended.
businesses.reinstateDialogBody: Its campaigns become eligible for the feed again.

moderation.pageDescription: Review submitted campaigns, flagged listings and pending voucher-batch requests.
moderation.campaignsEmptyDescription: Every submitted campaign has been reviewed.
moderation.campaignsTableCaption: Campaigns awaiting review, their audience/category and automated flags
moderation.approveCampaignDialogBody: This takes the campaign live and it appears in the feed.
moderation.rejectCampaignDialogBody: The business sees this reason in Studio and can revise and resubmit.
moderation.confirmOrChangeHint: Confirm the declared audience and category, or change either before approving. Only combinations this region's policy allows are offered.
moderation.listingsEmptyDescription: No listing is currently flagged for review.
moderation.listingsTableCaption: Listings the automated screen flagged (an adult_only category), their merchant and audience/category
moderation.approveListingDialogBody: This joins the listing to the public catalogue.
moderation.rejectListingDialogBody: The listing stays out of the public catalogue.
moderation.emptyDescription: Every voucher-batch request has been reviewed.
moderation.tableCaption: Pending voucher-batch requests, their listing, quantity and reason
moderation.approveDialogBody: This mints the batch and the listing's stock rises by the requested quantity.
moderation.rejectDialogBody: No vouchers are minted. The merchant can submit a new request.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Search an account, view its ledger, and act on it.
users.searchPromptDescription: Enter an email or a user ID above.
users.emptyDescription: Try a different email or user ID.
users.releaseDescription: Releases the escrow this suspension created, returning available and pending points exactly as they were.

flash.suspended: The account was suspended and its points moved to escrow.
flash.released: The account was released and its points returned.
flash.error: That action could not be completed. Check the account's state and try again.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.intro: Captured-voucher disputes waiting for staff. Finance resolves one in the user's favour, posting a recovery line against the merchant.
disputes.emptyDescription: Every captured-voucher dispute has been picked up.
disputes.resolveDialogBody: Posts a recovery line against the merchant that captured this voucher and removes the dispute from the queue. This cannot be undone.

risk.title: Risk queue
risk.intro: Accounts the real-time RiskGate flagged. See why, then release a false positive or suspend a confirmed risk into escrow.
risk.emptyDescription: No account is waiting for review in this region.
risk.tableCaption: Flagged accounts, why they were flagged, and staff actions
risk.releaseDialogBody: The flag is cleared as a false positive. If the account's balance was auto-held, this releases that escrow too.
risk.suspendDialogBody: Confirms the risk and holds the account's current balance in escrow pending further review.

economy.receiptsPageDescription: Receipt points a partner pays from its receipt package: what is left, what has been paid and who earns most -- one region at a time.

receipts.emptyTitle: No receipt programmes in this region
receipts.emptyBody: No partner has an approved receipt funder here yet.
receipts.packagesEmpty: No receipt package has been bought yet, so receipts are not earning.
receipts.earnersEmpty: No receipts paid in the last 30 days.

economy.overviewPageDescription: Coverage, daily issuance, the reserve, the reported spread, and point purchases -- one region at a time.
economy.ratePageDescription: Change the backing rate. Finance only -- this number never appears anywhere else.
economy.marketingPageDescription: Fund streaks, receipts and goodwill from the marketing budget, and trip an emergency stop.
economy.settingsPageDescription: Every economy setting for this region, including points expiry.
economy.pendingCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing pending} one {# pending} other {# pending}}
economy.rateNotAvailableBody: The backing rate is visible to finance only.
economy.rateSecrecyTitle: This screen is the only place this number appears
economy.rateSecrecyBody: The backing rate never reaches any other screen, any other role, or any consumer or business client.
economy.killSwitchesEmptyTitle: No kill switch has ever been tripped
economy.pointsExpiryHint: Off in both regions by default (F2). Built and switchable per region below, like every other setting.
economy.identityCheckHint: A verified email from a permanent address (not a disposable one) before any points. Production always requires it; here the setting below switches it on, two-person approved.
economy.identityCheckHintProduction: A verified email from a permanent address (not a disposable one) before any points. Production always requires it, whatever the setting below says.

flash.proposed: The change was proposed and is awaiting a second approver.
flash.error: That action could not be completed.
flash.invalid: Check the form -- something was missing or not valid.

settlement.pageDescription: Weekly statements, disputes and payout approval -- one region at a time.
settlement.queueEmptyTitle: Nothing open or disputed right now

flash.resolved: The dispute was resolved. The statement is open again.
flash.proposed: The payout was proposed and is awaiting a second approver.
flash.error: That action could not be completed.
flash.invalid: Check the form -- something was missing or not valid.

check.paid: Paid. The processor shows the payout reached the bank.
check.failed: Failed. The processor shows the payout did not reach the bank.
check.pending: Still on its way. The processor has not finished the payout yet.
check.transferred: Transfer found. The payout goes out next.
check.nothing_found: Nothing found at the processor. You can propose a retry.

retry.dialogBody: A second staff member must approve before the payout is attempted again. Say why a retry is safe.
retry.awaitingSecondStaff: Waiting for a second staff member to approve.
retry.proposed: The retry was proposed and is waiting for a second staff member.
retry.approved: The retry was approved. The payout will be attempted again.

failureWhy.transfer_unconfirmed: The processor did not confirm the transfer within a day
failureWhy.payout_unconfirmed: The processor did not confirm the payout within a day
failureWhy.account_closed: The brand's bank account is closed
failureWhy.account_frozen: The brand's bank account is frozen
failureWhy.bank_account_restricted: The brand's bank account cannot receive payouts
failureWhy.bank_ownership_changed: The brand's bank account changed owner
failureWhy.could_not_process: The bank could not process the payout
failureWhy.debit_not_authorized: The bank account does not accept this kind of transfer
failureWhy.insufficient_funds: The processor's balance was too low to pay out
failureWhy.invalid_account_number: The bank account number is not valid
failureWhy.incorrect_account_holder_name: The account holder's name does not match the bank's records
failureWhy.invalid_currency: The bank account cannot receive this currency
failureWhy.no_account: The bank account could not be found
failureWhy.payout_failed: The processor reported a failure without saying why
failureWhy.canceled: The payout was cancelled at the processor
failureWhy.other: The processor gave a reason this console does not know ({code})

disbursement.awaitingAccount: Waiting for the brand's payout details

parkedPurchases.pageDescription: Card payments that did not turn into points. Refund them with a second staff member's approval, one region at a time.
parkedPurchases.explainer: The card is refunded in full, and the business buys again at today's price.
parkedPurchases.notRefundable: There is no payment reference to refund through. Check with the processor.
parkedPurchases.proposeDialogBody: The card is refunded {amount} in full once a second staff member approves.
parkedPurchases.awaitingSecondStaff: Waiting for a second staff member to approve.

flash.proposed: The refund was proposed and is waiting for a second staff member.
flash.approved: The refund was approved and the card is being refunded.

charities.pageDescription: Review charity applications. Only approved charities are listed to viewers.
charities.approveBody: It will be listed to viewers in {region}. Give a reason for the audit trail.
charities.rejectBody: The applicant will see this reason.

demo.title: Demo world
demo.intro: Rebuilds the demo brands, campaigns and vouchers and gives every demo login a fresh account. Old demo accounts are suspended and their points held. It takes a few minutes.
demo.queued: The reset has started. Demo logins work again in a few minutes.
demo.failed: The reset could not be started. Try again.

auctions.pageDescription: Open charity auctions in every region. Cancelling releases every bid and returns the voucher to its seller.
auctions.cancelBody: Every bid is released and the voucher goes back to the seller. Give a reason for the audit trail.
